title: Update RecipesTab to use RecipesListView
description: Modify CookbookApp/Tabs/RecipesTab.swift. Replace the EmptyStateView placeholder with RecipesListView, passing the configured folderURL from RecipesFolderStore. The tab can assume folderURL is non-nil (AppRoot gating enforces this). Retain the NavigationStack, .navigationTitle('Recipes'), and trailing gear Settings toolbar button.
acceptance_criteria: RecipesTab.swift no longer renders EmptyStateView as its primary content
RecipesListView is the primary content of the NavigationStack
Trailing gear icon Settings toolbar button is retained
RecipesListView receives a non-nil folderURL from RecipesFolderStore
RecipesFolderStore is accessed from environment — not re-instantiated in the tab
